What if you went to school in America for one day?

Students from other countries are often surprised by these. One, many classes start the day with the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag. Two, students switch classrooms every period, while teachers stay put. Three, rows of lockers in the hallways, just like in the movies.

But here's the twist. Four, high school sports are huge, and some football stadiums seat over ten thousand fans. Five, the yellow school bus fleet is the biggest mass transit system in the country. And prom, a fancy dance at the end of high school, can cost families hundreds of dollars.
